reason: A DSH web interface plugin that adds an archived-session panel for browsing, restoring, and deleting archived conversations; deletion is destructive and supported through host routes.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加已归档会话管理面板，支持搜索、筛选、排序、取消归档以及删除归档会话。
summaries.en: Adds an archived-session management panel to DSH Web with search, filtering, sorting, unarchiving, and deletion controls.

capabilities: Adds an archived-session management panel to the DSH web interface
Searches, filters, and sorts archived sessions
Permanently deletes individual, project-level, or all archived sessions, immediately or after restart
Exposes host routes for pending deletion, unarchiving, and deletion operations
